name: integration-detail
description: Integration detail body: a section head over a sticky numbered index (from 1025px) beside up to five parts — Overview (copy + product video), Key Capabilities (tinted cards), Supported Data (a table), How It Works (numbered steps) and Requirements (copy or a checklist + help card). Every part is optional; the index numbers whatever is present. Figma: Integrations Detail Page Template > Platform Section (7318:168656).

eyebrow.description: Small label above the section heading, e.g. Integration Details.

title.description: Section heading (H2), e.g. How Asset Panda PRO works with Slack. Line breaks are kept.

id_prefix.description: Start of the part anchors and the heading id: integration gives #integration-overview, #integration-capabilities, #integration-how-it-works, #integration-requirements. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter (e.g. guides on the Compare hub); anything else falls back to integration.

head_width.description: default keeps the section lede to 820px; full lets it run the whole container (Figma Compare hub, where it reads as one line at 1440).

size.description: default: the Figma template sizes. compact: a lighter body — section and part headings 20–24px, card and step titles 18px, body copy 16px, the table 15px, tighter cards (smaller icons and padding) and part spacing.

index.description: Show the numbered part index (a sticky list beside the parts from 1025px, jump chips above them below that). false: the parts run in one 780px column with no index. With no section title, the parts' headings are H2 (their cards/steps H3) instead of H3/H4.

nav_label.description: Accessible name of the part index (the <nav> landmark).

overview.description: Overview part. Keys: eyebrow, title (H3), paragraphs (array of strings), video_poster (image URL), video_url (YouTube, Vimeo or an .mp4/.webm file; without it the poster shows as a plain image), video_title (names the player and the poster), nav (index label; defaults to the eyebrow), logo (partner logo URL: with no video, the partner + Asset Panda PRO logo card on the colour wash fills the video slot — for pages whose hero carries the video), logo_alt (empty = decoration), brand_logo (empty = the kit panda PRO mark).

capabilities.description: Key Capabilities part. Keys: eyebrow, title, lede, nav, style (cards: the default tinted cards; timeline: the Ursa-style vertical timeline, a grey line with stepped dots, an arrowhead and a scroll-linked light band; titles and text only, icons are not shown), items (array). Each item: title (required), text, icon (image URL) or icon_svg (inline SVG; currentColor takes the tone), tone (indigo | teal | amber | rose; defaults cycle in that order).

data.description: Supported Data part (between Key Capabilities and How It Works): what the integration moves, as a table. Keys: eyebrow, title, lede, nav, style (default: a ruled table in a frame; compare: the Compare-guide table look, a plain label column, the second column under an indigo header on lavender cells with a green check, the third under a grey header on grey cells, rounded corners), columns (array of header labels), rows (array; each row an array of cell strings in column order — the first cell names the row), note (small print under the table, line breaks kept). From 640px a ruled table; below, each row becomes a card with its column labels. Anchor #integration-data.

steps.description: How It Works part. Keys: eyebrow, title, nav, items (array). Each item: title (required), text, tone (indigo | rose | teal | amber; defaults cycle in that order), links (optional array of { label, url }: arrow links listed under the step text, two columns from 768px when there are more than four). Items are numbered 1, 2, 3... guide (optional object: intro, label, url) adds one arrow link under the list, e.g. intro "Detailed setup:" + the knowledge-base article.

requirements.description: Requirements part. Keys: eyebrow, title, text (line breaks kept), items (array of strings: a checklist under the copy), note (small print under the checklist), guide (optional object: intro, label, url — one arrow link after the checklist, when the content puts "Detailed setup: ..." here rather than under the steps), nav, help (object: title, text, cta_label, cta_url, icon — image URL; empty uses the Asset Panda panda).
